### DevOps RAG — seed infra standards
Upserts the team's infra standards into Pinecone (index `devops-kb`) so the Terraform Plan Reviewer's `search_infra_docs` returns real policy to cite.

Run once (re-run after edits; `clearNamespace` wipes + reseeds).

**Wire-up:** OpenAI + Pinecone creds. Embeddings = text-embedding-3-small @ 1024 (must match the reviewer + the devops-kb index dimension).
